general/cfuncs.icn
column3: DYNAMIC LOADING. Vendor /home/resources/icon-master/ipl/cfuncs (bitcount.c internal.c lgconv.c pack.c + icall.h, and see external.c on the extlvals row) into this package and build a libcfunc.so against out/libscrip_rt.so, which already exports 10 of the 12 iconx internals the upstream library binds (alcexternal alcfile alcreal alcstr cnv_c_str cnv_int cnv_real cnv_str getdbl nulldesc; the missing palnum and rgbkey are ppm.c graphics only and neither program touches them). Then teach the runner to put it on pathload's path (iconx does this by exporting FPATH=". <its own bin>"; we set no FPATH and pathload falls back to "."). MEASURED DISTANCE, with the oracle's own library lent to us: m3 prints 16 of 19 ref lines -- all 14 bitcount lines correct -- and dies Run-time error 101 at vword. Full measurement and controls in OUTSIDE_ARIZONA_BASELINE.tsv. hq_T 2026-09-11, ceo CEO-527/CEO-578.

column1: general/cfunc.icn
column3: A link target of loadfunc wrappers over libcfunc.so, the same dynamic-loading dependency as general/cfuncs.icn and general/extlvals.icn: a driver cannot be cut until ipl/cfuncs is vendored and loadfunc runs. Reclassified from REF_NOT_CUT by hq_icon 2026-09-25 -- still owed. OWED, never excluded. Prior evidence: IPL library module, NOT an arizona test: ipl/cfuncs/cfunc.icn, vendored as a link target (corpus 8f29d1dc3). Zero `procedure main` in the file, so the oracle cannot run it standalone -- it is a LINK TARGET for tests that `link` it. Upstream tests/general does not ship it (we ship 123 .icn there, upstream ships 99; all 24 extras are these). Oracle standalone: File cfunc.icn; Line 34 # ";": invalid declaration ⛔ ALSO BROKEN BY OUR OWN VENDORING EDIT, not by the oracle: CONTROL -- icont -s -c compiles upstream ipl/cfuncs/cfunc.icn cleanly and REFUSES this copy (File cfunc.icn; Line 34 # ";": invalid declaration). Cause: a blanket semicolon pass that also hit $-preprocessor directives and declarations, which take no ';'.
